title: 5/3/1 & Deep Water: Mythical Mass
author: Mithosphere
desc:
This is a brutal, 32-week periodized journey designed to completely overhaul you physique, work capacity, and mental fortitude. This macrocycle combines Jim Wendler's legendary 5/3/1 templatess with Jon Andersen's infamous Deep Water trilogy. You will transition systematically from high-volume barbell hypertrophy to ultimate athletic conditioning and sheer muscular survival.

THE 32-WEEK ROADMAP
Weeks 1-6: 5/3/1 Boring But Big Beefcake
+ Focus: Hypertrophy and baseline strength.
+ Structure: Main 5/3/1 lifts followed by a brutal 5x10 at FSL (First Set Last) percentages, completed within strict time limits. Time to eat.
Week 7: Deload
Weeks 8–13: 5/3/1 Building the Monolith
+ Focus: Maximum size, strength, and work capacity.
+ Structure: Massive weekly volume, high-rep widowmaker squats. Recover HARD.
Week 14: Deload
Weeks 15-20: Deep Water Beginner
+ Focus: Breaking mental barriers and building terrifying work capacity.
+ Structure: Introduction to the 10x10 protocol. You start with 4 minutes of rest, dropping to 2 minutes by the end.
Weeks 21-26: Deep Water Intermediate
+ Focus: Consolidating volume.
+ Structure: The 10x10 progression morphs - completing the 100 total reps in just 9 sets, then 8 sets.
Weeks 27–32: Deep Water Advanced
+ Focus: Peak intensity and realization.
+ Structure: Rest intervals tighten even further as you push heavy, high-rep sets to absolute failure.

CRITICAL RULES
+ 5/3/1 use a TM at 85-90%. This is NOT your 1RM. Take your 1RM and multiply it by 0.85 or 0.90, lower is considered better. Then the weighs will be adjusted accordingly. Week 4, increase your TM by 5 lbs on upper body lifts and 10 lbs on lower. Same goes for end of week 6, beginning of week 11, and the end of week 13.
+ Deep Water uses a true 1RM - simplified here on Boostcamp. Take your TMs from the end of 5/3/1 and make calculate the 1RM or e1RM. The app will calculate the weights from here. You may consider raising your 1RMs for all lifts at the end of each Deep Water block - not required - 5 lbs for upper and 10 lbs for lower.

NUTRITION & RECOVERY
Remember your goal isn’t to become Cardio Queen and if you get fat when you train like this, it’s because you simply aren’t working hard enough to support the calories. You must EAT to recover. You must EAT to grow. Prioritize sleep, hydration, and mobility. If your sleep is poor, the 10x10 squats will break you.

CONDITIONING
Follow the program, conditioning must fit with the goals here. Nothing should be heavily taxing as it WILL interfere with weight training. If conditioning days are not specified, take a rest day.

QUESTIONS
If there are specific questions, refer to the individual programs found online or ask on Boostcamp.
